changes.motivation: Remote builders were self-destructing during active `nix-store --serve --write` transfers because the inactivity monitor only tracked `nixbld` build processes, not nix-store serve sessions.
changes.summary: Added `pgrep -fc 'nix-store.*--serve'` as field 20 (`sv`) to `remote-stats.sh`, extending the wire format from 19 to 20 pipe-delimited fields.

changes.motivation: Prevent the inactivity monitor from shutting down a builder while it is actively serving store paths to the local machine.
changes.summary: Added a second `pgrep -f 'nix-store.*--serve'` check in `is_active()` inside `inactivity-monitor.nix`; a match resets the idle counter to 0 identical to the existing `nixbld` check.

changes.motivation: Expose the new transfer count to status consumers (CLI, waybar, any future tooling) via the structured JSON status file.
changes.summary: Updated `builder-status.sh` to parse field 20 from the stats stream into a `transfers` key in the per-builder status JSON.

changes.motivation: Allow operators to see at a glance whether a builder is actively receiving data and prevent the shutdown command from running while transfers are in flight.
changes.summary: Added an XFERS column to `builders-cli.sh`'s dashboard view and updated the shutdown eligibility check to block when `transfers > 0` (alongside the existing `builds > 0` guard), displaying 'active' in the shutdown column for either condition.

changes.motivation: Surface transfer activity alongside build activity in the Waybar status bar tooltip so users have full visibility without opening the dashboard.
changes.summary: Added a `transfers_cell` to the jaq-generated tooltip in `waybar-builders.sh`, rendering 'N xfers' per builder row next to the existing builds cell.

problems: The PRD `task-spec.md` template was not found in the repository — the agent tried four different glob patterns before giving up and writing self-contained specs inline. If a canonical task-spec template path is expected, it should be documented or the file should exist.
